base: Frozen source-face-v3 feature ownership, scene protection and gated 65 percent native eye texture
calibration: Fixed original facial reference minus the matching chronological source-anchor expression; horizontal eye, mouth and jaw offsets excluded
anchor: Freeze referenceTime minus output-frame-aligned trim start; bind the exact prepared-source video and decoded anchor frame in receipts
visibility: Require a single confident pose-compatible anchor face and at least one visible eye in both anchor and reference. Disable calibration for hidden anchor eyes. Record an explicit skipped-calibration reason when unavailable
expression: Standard source performance only; vertical eye calibration is gated by current visible source-eye area relative to its anchor. No reference mouth or jaw offsets
identity: Existing fixed donor and 60 percent Hyperswap RGB blend before the unchanged v3 feature compositor
limitations: Not an anatomy, identity, gaze or mouth-closure guarantee. Regional and paid v1/v2/v3 runs retain their frozen routes. No extra models or implicit setup
